consideredAndDeclined.why: Declined after testing it rather than waving it through, because this is the one place where grading my own finding could have gone wrong in either direction. Three things settled it. First, my verdict scoped the finding to initialStates[G04.fleet.*] and basedOn; faulting a field I did not name would be moving the goalposts on a repair. Second, the family norm: g03-input-corpus.v1 — the artifact I held up in that very finding as doing this correctly — has whatIsAuthored reading 'Named initial states drawn from live G03 v4 exactByteIntent: four D-102 fleet labels × …', and I verified the label is likewise absent from G03 v4's exactByteIntent and present only in its fleetClass. The construction names the harness's principal field as an umbrella and defers precise provenance to the per-state sources. Filing it here would fault the model artifact too. Third, and decisively, the defect I found was that no pinned document carried the content; that is gone. The authorityClaim, purpose, basedOn and all twelve state sources name G03 v4 fleetClass, so nothing in this artifact leaves a reader unable to reach the labels.

coordinatorSummary: ACCEPT at 0 blockers and 0 SHOULD-FIX. Thirty attacks run, none landed. Custody holds: subject a62c38d1 at 0444, 16721 bytes, unmoved; HEAD never left 5d5d778; required-now 26 of 26; file 08 and COORD unmodified; predecessor v1 unmoved at e97f5634 and my own v1 verdict unmoved at 39e9b739, both pinned by this artifact. All seven cited pins reproduce, and the seven 64-hex strings and seven quoted paths are the same seven — v1 carried three, and the four added are the repair. CLAUDE-G04IC-V1-SF1 is landed, tested limb by limb against what the finding actually said. basedOn now pins harness.DR-G03.core-startup.v4.json, which reproduces and whose independent review is ACCEPT 0/0; all four fleet labels are byte-exact substrings of that file's .harness.fleetClass, each heading exactly three states; all twelve fleet sources carry 'Fleet-class label from G03 v4 fleetClass', counted twelve of twelve; and the three bare integers my verdict recorded as having no pinned home — 4, 7 and 16 — are now resident in that pinned field. I confirmed G03 v4 is the live G03 occupancy rather than assuming it: four G03 files exist, v4 is highest, carries artifactPathWhenAuthored pointing at itself, holds the fleetClass field, and is what g03-input-corpus.v1 pins. The over-correction pass came back clean, and this mattered more than the landing. Sixteen states in, sixteen out, zero added or removed, and zero stateNamed, classMemberVerbatim or assertsNamedNotAuthored altered — correct, because the defect was provenance, not content. Exactly twelve source fields changed and they are exactly the twelve the finding named; the four non-fleet sources are untouched. doesNot is byte-identical to v1's, so no prohibition was weakened, and the added authorityClaim clauses only narrow. G03 is not retargeted: zero DR-100, OBL-G03, G03-row or leftoverDesign occurrences, and the g03v4 role refuses it explicitly. The excluded identifiers fleetClass names — macos-26-intel and Private 2 CPU / 8 GB — are absent, and all thirteen Rosetta occurrences are refusals. One call deserves the coordinator's attention because I nearly went the other way. whatIsAuthored is byte-identical to v1's and still reads 'drawn from live G04 v1 exactByteIntent: four D-102 fleet labels', which is the attribution my finding was about. I declined to file it on three grounds: my verdict scoped the finding to the twelve state sources and basedOn, so faulting an unnamed field would move the goalposts on a repair; the custody defect itself is gone, since four separate places now name G03 v4 fleetClass; and decisively, g03-input-corpus.v1 — the artifact I held up in that very finding as the correct model — uses the identical construction, with its own labels equally absent from the exactByteIntent its summary names. Filing here would have condemned the standard I set. Disclosure: this repairs my own SHOULD-FIX, the subject pins my verdict and names my finding id, and the G04 v1, G04 v3 and G03 v4 verdicts it depends on are all mine. I graded against live bytes rather than against my own prose, and the hard call above is recorded in full so it can be overruled rather than taken.
